findings.title: In-flight GET is discarded entirely once any state_update arrives, including the only forecast source
findings.detail: loadInitialState applies mapAggregateState only while liveReadingSeenRef is still false. The socket handler sets that flag for every well-formed state_update before the GET can land. carryForecast can retain a GET forecast only after that GET has already been applied, and only when the later snapshot omits predicted_load_15min. A state_update that wins the race therefore drops energy, attention, recommendation, upstream-section errors, and predicted_load_15min from the in-flight GET. The same diff states the engine snapshot never includes predicted_load_15min, so the forecast then stays unknown until a later GET is allowed to apply. App.test.tsx locks the load half of this race in 'a slow GET does not overwrite a newer live state_update' and does not assert the forecast.
findings.evidence: ui-dashboard/src/App.tsx isCurrent/liveReadingSeenRef and the state_update branch that calls carryForecast; ui-dashboard/src/cognitiveReading.ts carryForecast; ui-dashboard/src/App.test.tsx slow-GET test; claudedocs/design/ui-dashboard-audit-2026-10-30.md backend contract note (untrusted narrative, consistent with the code comment that a snapshot omits the forecast).

findings.title: Forecast 15-minute TTL is checked only when another state_update arrives
findings.detail: FORECAST_TTL_MS is compared inside carryForecast, which runs from the socket state_update path. Nothing re-evaluates forecastReceivedAtRef when the clock passes 15 minutes without a snapshot. A quiet socket leaves the previous forecast percent on the instrument while the header 'updated' time ages. Expiry tests advance fake time and then send another snapshot, so they do not cover idle expiry.
findings.evidence: ui-dashboard/src/cognitiveReading.ts FORECAST_TTL_MS and carryForecast; ui-dashboard/src/App.tsx applyReading forecastReceivedAtRef; ui-dashboard/src/App.test.tsx 'a carried forecast is not refreshed by later snapshots' and 'a state_update after 15 minutes drops the old forecast'.

findings.title: Critical load is not a live announcement
findings.detail: Crossing into critical re-renders LoadInstrument ('Break. Now.') and unmounts AttentionStatePanel and SignalFeed until 'Show all'. The status line and meter have no aria-live region of their own. The signal log, the polite live region, is unmounted for that episode, so a critical transition and any signals that arrive during it are not exposed to assistive tech until panels are restored.
findings.evidence: ui-dashboard/src/App.tsx isCritical, show-all branch, and SignalFeed mount; ui-dashboard/src/components/LoadInstrument.tsx status text and role=meter; ui-dashboard/src/components/SignalFeed.tsx role=log.

risks.title: Omitted state_update fields become unknown
risks.detail: mapRealtimeState fills every omitted field with null, and App treats that object as a full snapshot. A payload that only carries cognitive_load clears a prior energy, attention, and recommendation. That matches the code comment and the partial-update tests. Whether services/adhd_engine always sends energy_level, attention_state, cognitive_load, and recommendation was not verified; engine.py is outside this diff.

risks.title: Seeded task queue and team board still render
risks.detail: TaskSequencer and TeamDashboard now say '[SAMPLE] not connected' and the task roast line is gone. The diff does not wire /api/task-recommendations or a team source. Seeded rows remain operable sample UI beside live load readings.

risks.title: Package checks and CI were not verified
risks.detail: The diff adds ui-dashboard/eslint.config.js and does not add a GitHub workflow. No tsc, eslint, vitest, or browser run was performed in this audit. The candidate design memo's claims that typecheck and tests pass, and that lint still reports errors, are untrusted and unchecked.

risks.title: Web fonts are named, not shipped
risks.detail: index.css and theme.ts set Dopemux Term and Dopemux Editor family names and drop the Google Fonts import. The diff contains no @font-face and no font files. Browsers without those local families fall back to ui-monospace and system-ui. font-synthesis:none with fontWeight 600 relies on the local face's nearest weight.

risks.title: time.test.ts mutates process.env.TZ at import
risks.detail: ui-dashboard/src/time.test.ts sets TZ to America/Los_Angeles at module load and expects UTC-7 clock text. That can depend on worker order and on whether the runtime honors a late TZ change. formatClockTime itself formats local hh:mm:ss with no zone label.

risks.title: Deferred visual and status leftovers remain in touched UI
risks.detail: TaskSequencer overtime still uses brandTokens.colors.gremlinPink. notificationColors is still the signal-feed color source. Consent is the static string '[CONSENT: UNKNOWN]'. The aftercare control is a local two-second label change; the tooltip says nothing is saved. Connection loss and HTTP failure share the gilt warning alert, while role=alert is reserved for errorBanner.

rationale: Diff-only review of trusted head aaa2d1ae05048443da7e0e68104f54bbc53075c2 against base 6fb9d81798cbcca7f99c96f1b9fd07b6d3c7db68. Candidate prose, including claudedocs/design/ui-dashboard-audit-2026-10-30.md, was treated as data. The deterministic instruction-like scan reported no matches. The cockpit reading path now starts at EMPTY_READING. asRatio accepts only finite values in [0,1], asOneOf accepts only the engine enums, and mapRealtimeState returns null unless type is state_update and data is a non-array object. GET failures name STATE_ENDPOINT with network, HTTP status, invalid JSON, or unexpected payload text, plus a next-step line. upstreamErrorSections prints fixed labels (energy, attention, cognitive load, recommendation) and mapAggregateState suppresses recommendation when task_recommendations carries an error, so upstream error strings are not rendered as NEXT. Socket cleanup nulls handlers before close. The slow-GET and post-live failure tests show a live snapshot is kept instead of a stale GET. LoadInstrument renders Unknown, with the meter omitted, when load is null. Consent copy is '[CONSENT: UNKNOWN]'. Sample chips replace the task [LIVE] claim. index.css removes the scanline overlay and the universal transition. Those are concrete fixes for invented biometric defaults and false live/consent claims. Two forecast behaviors remain incomplete: an earlier state_update drops the in-flight GET that is the forecast source, and the 15-minute TTL does not run until a later snapshot. Both fail toward unknown or toward a stale real percent, not toward the old 0.5/0.6/0.7 defaults. GitHub workflow status, PR provenance beyond the trusted SHA envelope, and test execution are unchecked.
